ai_productivity.title: ⚡ AI & Productivity
ai_productivity.content:
• **OpenAI:** GPT-5-Turbo has shipped with a 2M token context window and an MMLU score of 91.2%. It delivers 120 tokens/sec at a cost of $10 per million input tokens, marking a 40% speed increase over GPT-4o. Developers can now upload an entire enterprise codebase and request a full security audit and refactor in a single prompt without implementing a RAG pipeline. OpenAI Blog

• **Anthropic:** Claude 3.7 Sonnet is now available, featuring a 500k context window and a HumanEval score of 94.1%. It operates at 90 tokens/sec for $3 per million input tokens, offering a significantly higher reasoning-to-cost ratio than Gemini 1.5 Pro. Knowledge workers can now automate the synthesis of 50+ disparate PDFs into a formatted strategic report with zero hallucinated citations. Anthropic News

• **Perplexity:** Perplexity Pages 2.0 has shipped, integrating a real-time collaborative "Live-Canvas" for AI-generated research reports. This update transforms static reports into bidirectional workspaces where source citations update automatically as the user edits the generated text. This replaces the manual loop of copying AI research into Notion for collaborative editing and verification. TechCrunch AI

Why it matters: The industry is pivoting from retrieval-based systems (RAG) toward "infinite context" reasoning, fundamentally changing how developers handle large-scale data ingestion.
